title: Digit Mirror Gap
description:
## Task

Write the decimal digits of `n` backwards to get its mirror (leading zeros of the mirror simply vanish, so the mirror of `120` is `21`). Report how far apart `n` and its mirror are.

## Input

- `n` — a non-negative integer.

## Output

The absolute difference between `n` and its mirror.

## Example

```python
digit_mirror_gap(123)  # returns 198
digit_mirror_gap(120)  # returns 99
digit_mirror_gap(121)  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ `n` ≤ 10^18
